system_source.weights: VGGT-1B (huggingface.co/facebook/VGGT-1B, model.pt), SALAD + DINOv2 for loop detection (upstream scripts/download_weights.sh)

deviations_from_defaults: chunk_size 30 / overlap 15 instead of 60 / 30, to fit 16 GB of GPU memory (upstream was developed on a 24 GB RTX 4090; our cluster runs peaked at ~31.6 GB). Overlap kept at half the chunk, as in the default.
loop_chunk_size 15 instead of 20: a loop chunk holds 2 x loop_chunk_size images, so 40 images ran out of memory after all 115 regular chunks had finished; 30 matches the regular chunk.
Input frame rate 10 Hz (frame_step 3), as for VGGT-Long.

hardware.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 Ti Laptop GPU, 16384 MiB
